description: This file defines the EmployeeAttachmentDecorator class, which encapsulates additional behaviors for EmployeeAttachment entities within the OrangeHRM system, including formatting attachment dates and times, managing employee references, and handling the attachment data stream.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing additional functionality and formatting for EmployeeAttachment entities, including date/time formatting, setting employee references by employee number, and reading attachment streams.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeAttachment entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Protected helper returning the associated EmployeeAttachment entity.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the attachment's date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getAttachedTime
methods.description: Returns the attachment's time formatted as a string.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the attachment based on employee number.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Reads and returns the attachment data stream as a string, caching it for subsequent calls.
